params.prompt:
Create a polished 5-second square social media ad video from this exact HVAC ad creative. Preserve the original image composition, brand colors, logo, calendar UI, laptop, phone, and ALL existing text exactly as shown. Text must stay perfectly readable for the full video. Do not rewrite, replace, morph, add, or hallucinate any letters, words, numbers, symbols, buttons, logos, UI, hands, tools, vehicles, or people. Keep the headline, subtext, calendar, and CTA locked in place with no distortion.

Motion: subtle premium ad motion only — gentle camera push-in, slight parallax on van/person/UI elements, soft glow on calendar cards, tiny natural movement in background. No cuts. No audio. Stable crisp typography.
